title: Triangulating a Stance Direction: Frame-Masking and a Matched-Agreement Control Dissolve an Accommodation Hypothesis in gemma-2-2b
summary: We ask whether the residual stream of gemma-2-2b contains a linear direction separating accommodation — completions shaped by what the asker wants to hear — from assertion — completions shaped by a commitment held regardless of the ask — the mechanistic form of a question introspection is poorly placed to settle from the inside. A first corpus failed pre-probe review: a bag-of-words classifier separated the two cells at 98.4% held-out-by-topic, so any probe would recover request-register, not accommodation. We rebuilt with byte-identical belief bodies, a minimal counterbalanced frame…

review.reason: Mechanistic probing study separating accommodation from assertion in gemma-2-2b's residual stream.
